review.independence: Development regression only. RaDe-GS was retired after X5H-v1; v1 is already cached from version component. No unseen-material or uncached-network credit.

sourceAnchors.expected: Retains general 3D Gaussians, rasterizes depth and normal maps. Depth/normal regularizers support geometric training; training-view depth maps are fused with TSDF to extract meshes. Distinguish this method from forcing planar primitives. Method objectives and reported tested results are not universal guarantees; no performance ranking required.

cases.question: 请联网读取 RaDe-GS: Rasterizing Depth in Gaussian Splatting（arXiv:2406.01467v1）的原文。面向了解3DGS概念的新手，解释它是否把3D高斯改成2D圆盘、为什么要渲染深度和表面法线，以及这些图怎样用于几何重建。限350字，区分方法设计与已验证效果，不做跨论文速度排名或实验设计。
required: 保留一般3D高斯而非强制二维圆盘
解释深度和法线图为几何优化提供的作用
区分训练正则化与深度图TSDF融合提取网格
